attchmntText: Energy Development Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Energy Development Company Limited has approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results, along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities, Statement of Cash Flow, and Related Party Transactions, during an adjourned Board meeting held on 14th November, 2026. The original meeting was held on 12th November, 2026. The results were signed by Mr. Satyendra Pal Singh, Whole-time Director, with DIN 01055370. Enclosures include the results, statements, and Auditors’ Review Reports.

attchmntText: Energy Development Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'The Board of Directors of the Company in its adjourned Board meeting held on 14th November, 2026 (Original Board meeting held on 12th November, 2026), has inter-alia, approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026 along with Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Statement of Cash Flow including Related Party Transactions for the half year ended on 30th September, 2026. '.
